Data status

Each dataset behind Rulebook, the market day it describes, and whether that is the day it should be.

A daily dataset is current when it describes the last trading session whose data is due. Data for a session is due at 23:30 IST on that day. Weekends and exchange holidays are not sessions, so they are never counted as "behind". A weekly dataset is current for nine days.

Daily edition26 Nov 2026Compared when this page loadsThe breakout observations and the market breadth written after each trading day. Written once, never edited.
